say:2:1610221001:1.text: Headmaster Leymar has been a bit... unstable lately. I really don't know what he was thinking, hiding a page of the school rules like that.
say:2:1610221001:1.source_cn: 我觉得最近雷蒙校长的情绪有些不太稳定，真不知道把一页校...

say:3:1610221002:0.text: When I asked him about it, he started yelling. "All this transfiguration around campus is causing a ruckus! It'll be chaos during the selection!" The irony is that he used to be the biggest troublemaker of them all!
say:3:1610221002:0.source_cn: 还说什么“大家在校园内变成各种动物，实在是太吵闹了，会...

say:4:1610221003:0.text: Speaking of which, hasn't he been overworking himself lately? He even canceled this month's lecture. It seems the selection preparations are taking a significant toll on him.
say:4:1610221003:0.source_cn: 话说回来，最近雷蒙是不是太过操劳？连这个月的讲座都推掉...

say:5:1610221004:0.text: He's definitely overworked, Viktor. That man needs rest.
say:5:1610221004:0.source_cn: 维克托，他应该是累了，需要休息。

say:6:1610221005:0.text: I think I'll have a good, long talk with him after the selection is over.
say:6:1610221005:0.source_cn: 好吧，等到选拔赛结束了，我再找他好好聊一聊。

say:7:1610221006:0.source_cn: 那么，我们之前所说的校规……

say:9:1610221007:0.text: It seems Professor Zorya has found the person who took the page from the school rulebook. Apparently, it's this Professor Viktor.
say:9:1610221007:0.source_cn: 看来佐尔娅老师已经找到了拿走校规书页的人——正是这位名...

say:10:1610221008:0.text: Why is the transfiguration rule in his possession? Was it happenstance, or was it deliberate?
say:10:1610221008:0.source_cn: 他为什么要拿走变形术的那一页校规？他是无意的，还是故意的？

say:11:1610221009:0.text: It appears Professor Zorya knows him. Given that, rather than questioning yourself, you might as well just ask. Should anything go amiss, she'll help.
say:11:1610221009:0.source_cn: 看来佐尔娅老师跟他很熟悉。既然如此，与其自我疑问，不如...
say:11:1610221009:0.male: It appears Professor Zorya knows him. Given that, rather than questioning yourself, you might as well just ask. Should anything go amiss, she'll help.
say:11:1610221009:0.female: It appears Professor Zorya knows him. Given that, rather than questioning yourself, you might as well just ask. Should anything go amiss, she'll help.

say:15:1610221010:0.text: Excuse me, who are you? Were you eavesdropping just now?!
say:15:1610221010:0.source_cn: 你是谁？你怎么会知道我将一页校规藏起来了……你在偷听我...
say:15:1610221010:0.male: Excuse me, who are you? Were you eavesdropping just now?!
say:15:1610221010:0.female: Excuse me, who are you? Were you eavesdropping just now?!

say:16:1610221011:0.text: Don't be flustered, Viktor. This is <style="stress"><player_name></style>. He's a new student admitted through special admissions this year, and I must say, his command of magic is truly impressive.
say:16:1610221011:0.male: Don't be flustered, Viktor. This is <style="stress"><player_name></style>. He's a new student admitted through special admissions this year, and I must say, his command of magic is truly impressive.
say:16:1610221011:0.female: Don't be flustered, Viktor. This is <style="stress"><player_name></style>. She's a new student admitted through special admissions this year, and I must say, her command of magic is truly impressive.

say:17:1610221012:0.text: I'm not sure what's going on, Zorya. Headmaster Leymar told me to tear out the page, and now you're telling me to put it back. There has to be a reason for this.
say:17:1610221012:0.source_cn: 佐尔娅，校规是怎么回事？雷蒙让我将它撕去，你又让我将它...

say:18:1610221013:0.text: Oh, it's nothing to worry about! I merely have some... instructional requirements regarding transfiguration, so I spoke with the headmaster. He has kindly agreed to reinstate that specific page of the school rules.
say:18:1610221013:0.source_cn: 没什么，只是我有……嗯，变形术上的教学需要，所以说服了...

say:19:1610221014:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is simply handling a few errands on my behalf.
say:19:1610221014:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is simply handling a few errands on my behalf.
say:19:1610221014:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> is simply handling a few errands on my behalf.

say:20:1610221015:0.text: Wait, your class is unrelated to transfiguration.
say:20:1610221015:0.source_cn: 你？教学需要？你的课程不是和变形术无关吗？

say:21:1610221016:0.text: Remember, Viktor, all branches of magic are interconnected. As our foundational theory instructor, you understand this better than anyone.
say:21:1610221016:0.source_cn: 没有哪两门魔法课程是毫无关联的。维克托，你作为魔法基础...

say:22:1610221017:0.text: If you have doubts about my teaching methods, you may go to the headmaster's office and ask Leymar yourself.
say:22:1610221017:0.source_cn: 如果你对我的教学内容抱有怀疑，可以亲自去校长办公室问雷蒙。

say:23:1610221018:0.text: Forget it... The headmaster just does whatever he pleases, flitting from one idea to another like a child, never stopping to see the mess he's made.
say:23:1610221018:0.source_cn: ……算了，雷蒙总是这样想一出是一出，像个小孩子一样喜欢...

say:24:1610221019:0.text: Since he already talked to you, I have nothing to hide either.
say:24:1610221019:0.source_cn: 既然他已经答应了你，那我也没什么好隐瞒的。

say:25:1610221020:0.text: I found a tree stump in the <style="highlight">Whisperwood across from the graveyard</style> and <style="highlight">sealed</style> the page of the school rules inside it. Turns out, many students use it to hide their secrets.
say:25:1610221020:0.source_cn: 我在<style=highlight>墓园对面的幽茂林...

say:26:1610221021:0.text: I see. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please go and retrieve that page for me?
say:26:1610221021:0.male: I see. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please go and retrieve that page for me?
say:26:1610221021:0.female: I see. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please go and retrieve that page for me?

choice_prompt:27:1610221021.text: I see. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please go and retrieve that page for me?
choice_prompt:27:1610221021.source_cn: 我知道了。<style=stress><player_name></style>，你替我跑一趟，将那页记载了变形术的校规拿回来吧。
choice_prompt:27:1610221021.male: I see. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please go and retrieve that page for me?
choice_prompt:27:1610221021.female: I see. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, could you please go and retrieve that page for me?

say:28:1610221022:0.text: Alright, after you've recovered the school regulation, please ensure it is returned to its proper place. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must begin preparing for tomorrow's lessons.
say:28:1610221022:0.source_cn: 好，找回校规后，放回原处即可。我要去备明天的课了。
say:28:1610221022:0.male: Alright, after you've recovered the school regulation, please ensure it is returned to its proper place. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must begin preparing for tomorrow's lessons.
say:28:1610221022:0.female: Alright, after you've recovered the school regulation, please ensure it is returned to its proper place. Now, if you'll excuse me, I must begin preparing for tomorrow's lessons.

say:29:1610221023:0.text: Wait, Zorya, we can go to the teaching building together. I also have to prepare lessons.
say:29:1610221023:0.source_cn: 等等，佐尔娅，一起走吧，我也要去教学楼备课。

choice:12:0:1.text: Did you hide that page of the school rules?
choice:12:0:1.source_cn: 您将那一页校规藏在哪里了？
choice:12:0:1.male: Did you hide that page of the school rules?
choice:12:0:1.female: Did you hide that page of the school rules?

choice:12:1:2.text: I'm looking for that lost page.
choice:12:1:2.source_cn: 您好，我是来找丢失的校规的
choice:12:1:2.male: I'm looking for that lost page.
choice:12:1:2.female: I'm looking for that lost page.
